mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_order (order_no, user_id, total_amount, actual_amount, status, payment_method, payment_time, shipping_address_id, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentTime}, #{shippingAddressId}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT o.* FROM mall_order o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
SELECT o.* FROM mall_order o WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) FROM mall_order WHERE status >= 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) FROM mall_order WHERE status >= 1 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM mall_order GROUP BY status
SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM mall_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
